name: Full Pen Fabrication LLC
old_description: We offer specialized commercial, residential, and industrial welding and metal fabrication services, working with a wide range of materials including carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and exotic metals. Our team of certified welders is equipped to deliver precise, durable solutions tailored to the unique demands of construction, manufacturing, and custom projects. Additionally, we provide subcontracting capabilities for projects of any scale, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability. From TIG and MIG welding to advanced custom fabrication, our commitment to excellence sets us apart.
about:
Full Pen Fabrication LLC operates from Deep River, Connecticut, providing welding and metal fabrication services across New England and nationwide. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure publicly; its primary contact is Billy Owens.

The shop delivers custom welding and fabrication using TIG and MIG processes, CNC plasma cutting and design, dustless surface blasting for eco-friendly coating removal, industrial-grade hot water pressure washing, and 24/7 emergency repair with code-enforced, X-ray-quality welds. It also offers mobile onsite welding and manpower subcontracting for projects of any scale. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Customers span commercial, residential, industrial, construction, and manufacturing sectors, with noted experience on government and Department of Defense contracts. The company serves clients throughout New England and accepts nationwide projects.

Full Pen Fabrication emphasizes safety, code compliance, and environmentally responsible methods such as dustless blasting. It promotes X-ray-quality fabrication standards and a commitment to precision and durability as distinguishing factors.
